events.title: Update 0.1.5 Meta Progression & Release of Final Demo
events.summary: Final Demo is Complete! We are excited to announce that the final demo is officially complete! This update comes packed with new features like achievements, permanent upgrades, and numerous quality-of-life improvements. After three months of dedicated playtesting and gathering player feedback, we’ve crafted a demo that reflects the community’s input. events.title: Update 0.1.4
events.summary: Exciting New Updates! Level Completion Screen: After finishing a level, you'll now see a stats screen showing how you did and what achievements you collected. Level Replay: From the main menu, you can now access the level selection screen to replay any level you've completed. Achievement Tracker: In the level selection screen, you can view the achievements you've earned and see which ones you're still missing for each level.
